intro: Bring your AI coding tools and providers together. Polaris handles routing, fallback, and format translation — on your own infrastructure.
demoNote: Illustrative preview. No live credentials or requests.
providersCopy: Connect 23 providers, from cloud accounts to models running on your own machine.
providerNote: OAuth, API keys, or a local endpoint. Available models depend on your provider and account.
featuresCopy: Let your tools do the coding. Let Polaris take care of the connection.
fallbackCopy: Smart fallback routes around rate limits, cooldowns, and exhausted credentials. Choose balanced, priority, weighted, latency, or cost-based routing.
controlCopy: Give each client a scoped virtual API key with budgets, rate limits, expiry, and model allowlists. Add optional guardrails before requests leave the gateway.
visibilityCopy: Inspect usage, request activity, and estimated costs in the console. Connect Prometheus metrics or optional Langfuse traces when you need more visibility.
startCopy: Start with Docker Compose: one worker, one replica, and built-in SQLite. A local console for you or your trusted team.
hostNote: Docker Compose v2 · Linux amd64. Windows: Docker Desktop with WSL2. macOS requires manual verification; Apple Silicon uses amd64 emulation. No native ARM64 image.
copyError: Could not copy. Select the commands and copy them manually.
setupNote: Open localhost:4283, complete preflight, then create an owner passphrase (12–256 characters).
localeNote: Polaris reviews English and Vietnamese semantically. Its 13 community console locales may fall back to English for missing messages.
closingTitle: One less thing between you and your next idea.
closingCopy: Build with the tools you love. Connect them with Polaris.
footer: Universal AI routing for coding tools.
title: Polaris — One gateway for your AI tools
loadError: Could not load this language. Please try again.
maintenance: Back up your data before updating an existing installation.
qualityCopy: Token-aware conversation cleanup preserves system instructions, tool-call relationships and recent messages. Configure optional guardrails and exact-response caching in AI Quality.
routeDesc: Your tools keep their API. Polaris finds the way.
routeNote: One gateway. Native protocols. Automatic fallback.
credDesc: Accounts, API keys, and provider health in one place.
activityDesc: Follow each request, from first attempt to response.
